system.description:
FOCUS FORCE SAVE TECHNIQUE Action 1 to 3 AP

You release a concentrated burst of force. If you spend 1 AP, creatures in a 15-foot cone take 2d6 force damage. If you spend 2 AP, the cone is 30 feet and damage is 3d6. If you spend 3 AP, the cone is 60 feet and damage is 4d6. Each creature in the area attempts a basic Fortitude save against your Technique Save DC. This is a magical technique using the tradition of your Monastic Path.

Automated: target the creatures in the cone, then press Use and choose 1, 2 or 3 AP. The damage is rolled once, and each target makes a basic Fortitude save against your Technique Save DC (10 + your Monastic Path's ability + your level). The damage is magical force.
